en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ibn Abu Umer, from Abu Jreer Al Qummy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Hajj is Necessitated upon the people of Al-Jeddah during every year’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ya’qub ibn Yazid from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Jarir al- Qummiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Performing al-Hajj is obligatory upon people of Jaddah every year.’”
